text:
Tom Harris: Quick sync for SX Summit co-hosted launchpad session w/ Orbit & CloudFoundry. Main asks: final speaker lineup, who sends demo VMs, swag custody transfer, and a short list of AV spares. Can we finalize by Thu?
Helena Ortiz: Ill own speaker sequencing and handoff script. Proposing Partner-A -> Orbit -> Redwood -> CloudFoundry. Each gets 8m + 2m for Q. Need headshots + 1-liners by Wed.
Yusuf Khan: Demo infra: Orbit wants to bring 2 pre-configured VMs. Prefer we stage them at Redwood for network tests. I can run perf checks and assign static IPs.
Carla Nguyen: Swag custodian question: should partners drop bundles at our booth or ship direct to event warehouse? Shipping to Redwood HQ gives QA time but adds lead time. Customs for EU partners needs HS codes.
Lia Gomez: I recommend mixed approach: local EU partners ship direct; North America stage at Redwood. Lia here  I will own manifest + PO and produce 35 attendee bundles + 10 VIP packs. Will include co-branded sticker and QR card to repo.
ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: rehearsal 2026-07-01 11:00 PT. Dry-run auto-DM to presenters 30m before.
Tom Harris: AV & spares: bring 1 HDMI encoder, 2 USB-C adapters, spare ethernet, and a battery-powered hotspot as fallback. Also, ensure laptop operators know to disable sleep.
Helena Ortiz: Can someone handle raw partner feeds? We need an unedited partner-only track for post-launch edits. I'll take the edited attendee stream.
Yusuf Khan: Ill capture partner raw on a local recorder and rsync to s3://media.redwood/sx-launchpad/. Will also scrub any debug tokens before upload.
Carla Nguyen: For swag: include a short "how to return loaner" insert for any hardware. Also propose a small raffle: 5 VIP bundles reserved for survey winners. Need legal sign-off for EU giveaways. Tagging legal in follow-up.
Lia Gomez: Ill add hotline + support email on the insert (support@redwood.ai) and a QR to the demo repo. Partners to provide logos by Tue for co-branding.
Tom Harris: Run-of-show v0.2 below, please flag conflicts.
Tom Harris: ```
14:00 Booth load-in & AV check
14:30 Welcome + quick intros (5m)
14:35 Partner lightning slot (4 x 8m)
15:07 Demo showcase (3 partners, 12m each, 3m swap)
16:03 Raffle + closing CTAs + post-event survey link
```
Helena Ortiz: Suggest swapping order of demo showcase: put the hardware partner in the middle to avoid audio bleed from live rigs. Also keep a 5m buffer between demos for network resets.
Yusuf Khan: Agree on buffer. Ill pre-warm model caches and stage KV snapshots to reduce cold starts. Also will bring a small USB flash with pre-recorded fallback clips.
Carla Nguyen: Logistics note: if partners opt to ship directly to venue, ask them for tracking + customs docs and cc Redwood logistics. Lia, can you add that to the manifest?
Lia Gomez: Will do. Also will print return labels for loaners and include a packing checklist inside each box.
ops-bot: Vendor SLA reminder: international shipments require tracking + insurance.
Tom Harris: Final quick actions: Helena  speaker order + handoff script by Wed. Yusuf  staging + perf report by Wed. Lia  manifest + swag packing list by Thu. Carla  confirm customs invoices or partner direct shipping opt-in by Thu.
Helena Ortiz: I'll circulate speaker notes in 2 hours. Also, please rehearse transitions (host script) to avoid awkward pauses.
Yusuf Khan: Network perf test scheduled for 2026-06-30 09:00 PT. I'll post results in #eng-network.
Lia Gomez: Shipping labels queued for NA staging. I'll DM partners about co-brand approvals and post tracking in #logistics once printed.
Carla Nguyen: Thanks all. If we can close items by Thu EOD well have time for a final dry-run. :rocket:
